headline: Executive order adjusts certain federal pay rates, likely the yearly update to pay schedules for federal workers.
what_it_does: This order changes certain rates of pay set by the federal government. Orders with this title are usually issued each December to set the new year's pay tables for federal civilian employees, members of the military, and senior officials. No summary was provided, so the specific pay changes and who they cover cannot be confirmed from the title alone.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may be adjusted under the new schedules set by the order.
Their basic pay rates may be adjusted if the order covers military pay, as these yearly orders usually do.
